## Agentic AI - Digital Product Launchpad (Step 1-6)

### How it works

This workflow turns a submitted product idea into a launched digital product using a sequence of AI and automation steps. It researches and outlines the product, writes the content, converts it to a PDF, uploads it to Google Drive, creates sales copy, deploys the product to a digital storefront, and generates marketing content. A separate purchase webhook handles successful transactions by emailing the product file and sending a testimonial request three days later.

### Setup steps

- Configure the product-idea webhook URL and ensure the incoming payload includes the product idea or brief required by the Gemini prompts.
- Add Google Gemini credentials and review each AI prompt for research, writing, sales copy, and marketing content generation.
- Configure PDFShift API authentication for the Markdown-to-PDF conversion request.
- Connect Google Drive credentials and choose the destination folder for uploaded product PDFs.
- Configure the Lynk.id API request with the correct endpoint authentication, product fields, pricing, and file/link mapping.
- Set up the successful-payment webhook from the store or payment provider, and configure the email sending credentials for product delivery and follow-up emails.

### Customization

You can customize the Gemini prompts, PDF styling, Drive folder, store product fields, pricing, marketing channel copy, delivery email template, and the H+3 wait duration for testimonial follow-up.

## Capture and draft product

Starts the launch workflow from a product-idea webhook, then uses Gemini agents to research the idea, create an outline, and write the main product content.

## Create and store PDF

Converts the generated Markdown content into a PDF through PDFShift and uploads the finished product file to Google Drive.

## Launch and promote store

Generates sales copy, creates the digital product in the Lynk.id storefront, and produces promotional marketing content for the launched product.

## Deliver purchase follow-up

Handles successful transaction notifications, emails the product file to the buyer, waits three days, and sends a testimonial request email.
